description: Start a Brain document file upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown, 10 MB max): returns a signed upload_url that the client PUTs the raw file to, with the returned content-type header, and an upload_id valid for 2 hours. Then call aidelly_complete_brain_document_upload with the upload_id. Works only for clients with direct network access to Supabase storage, such as Claude Code or a local CLI; the hosted server hides it from browser-sandboxed chat clients, which use aidelly_add_brain_document instead. Requires workspace settings permission. Retry-safe with the same idempotency_key.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

file_size.description: File size in bytes (10 MB max).

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_brain_document_upload_url
title: Create Brain Document Upload Url
